pages.text: Taro's house is on this side of the village road. Mumu's house is on the other side. Taro has quick hands. Mumu has sharp ears. Every morning, they meet in the middle of the road.
"Let's play under the big tree today!" Taro waved. "Okay! I'll come after breakfast." They each went home.
But there are two big trees in this village. One stands beside the well. The other stands beside the stream.
Taro went to the tree by the well. "I'm here first." He sat in the shade and waited for Mumu.
Mumu went to the tree by the stream. "I'm here first." Mumu sat in the shade and waited for Taro.
Taro set down stones one by one. Tap, tap, tap. One, two, three... twenty. "Why isn't Mumu coming?"
Mumu set down leaves one by one. One, two, three... thirty. "Why isn't Taro coming?"
Mumu pricked up their ears. "What's that sound?" Far away came tap, tap, tap.
Mumu followed the sound, running in bounds. "Taro!" Taro sat under the tree by the well. A toad sat beside him.
"This is the well tree." "No, it's the toad tree!" They looked at each other and laughed.
